title: The Cartel That Used a Sea Turtle Rescue Center to Smuggle Cocaine in Shells
hook: They drilled into live sea turtles, stuffed cocaine inside, and sewed them back up—then released them into the ocean for pickup.
why_this_can_go_viral: The animal cruelty angle triggers strong emotional reactions, while the method is so bizarre it demands explanation.

hook: He'd check out true crime books, read the check-out history, and hunt down people who borrowed the same titles.
why_this_can_go_viral: Relatable setting (libraries) meets horror, triggering 'I need to stop borrowing books' paranoia.

why_this_can_go_viral: The 'hidden poison in plain sight' angle is deeply unsettling and relatable to anyone with allergies.

title: The White-Collar Criminal Who Stole a Bank's Entire IT System—by Becoming the Janitor
hook: He mopped the server room floor for six months, memorized every password on sticky notes, and copied the entire database to a USB in his mop bucket.

title: The Unsolved Murder Where the Victim's Final Text Was a Photo of Their Own Killer

title: The White-Collar Criminal Who Stole a University's Research Grant—by Creating Fake Professors
